name: QRdx
tagline: Design QR codes and barcodes with a scan check
description: A remote MCP server that designs QR codes for links, Wi-Fi, contacts, email, SMS, locations and bank payments, scores how well each design scans, adjusts the style until the score is Great, and returns SVG, PNG and a playground link. It also checks and renders barcodes such as EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 128, Data Matrix, PDF417 and Aztec. No API key is needed; a QRdx API key only adds saving themes and barcodes to a workspace.
